==Description==
'''Nutcracker''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 9 of the premium [[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Battle Pass]] track. It was made by STEALTH_NOVA. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to interact with it.

When used, the player will be forced to walk like a nutcracker.

It had a cost of {{PlushieSnowman|220}} or {{Robux|123}} ({{Robux|98}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale), with a total cost of {{PlushieSnowman|1,000}} or {{Robux|540}} ({{Robux|428}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale).
